description: Because removal is a civil matter, there is no right to appointed counsel. Detainees are held in jails and contracted facilities regardless.
energy_note: Jailed by a process that is officially not punishment.

aspect: Representation changes outcomes enormously and costs money
description: Represented respondents fare dramatically better than unrepresented ones, so the outcome correlates with whether the family could raise a retainer that week.
energy_note: The verdict tracks the size of the retainer.

aspect: Transfer breaks the case and the visits
description: Detainees are moved between facilities and states, separating them from counsel, evidence and family without notice.
energy_note: Moved overnight, and the lawyer is now in another state.

aspect: Bond is set in money he does not have
description: Where bond is available at all it is set in thousands of dollars, so the difference between waiting outside and waiting inside is simply cash.

aspect: SCENE - the facility in another state
description: His wife drives six hours to the visit. When she arrives they tell her he was transferred on Friday to a facility in Louisiana. Nobody called her. Nobody called the lawyer either, and the hearing is Thursday.
energy_note: Six hours each way, to be told he left on Friday.
